subject: Dedicated deployment: isolation validation, TTL proposals, and operational evidence
messages:
From: Karen Lee <security@finsecure.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Validation request: Dedicated region isolation & TTL proposals

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the call earlier. To close our audit loop we need a few concrete items from Redwood for our Dedicated deployment evaluation:

- A diagram showing the exact "pin scope" for our tenant (which racks/regions hold persistent copies vs. ephemeral caches).
- Confirmation of retention/TTL for: model artifacts, KV cache/prefix cache, inference logs, and snapshot backups. We need the default and the maximum configurable value.
- Evidence of delete/wipe: what artifacts we can request to be purged, and the observable evidence you can provide (log extract, snapshot deletion events).
- Your proposed timeline for a certified tenant wipe and a sample runbook we can use in SRE exercises.

Can you provide the documents and a short operational walkthrough next week (30 minutes)? Also please include any limitations (e.g., backup replication windows) that might extend the wipe timeline.

Appreciate a written response so our audit team can close out the item.

Best,
Karen Lee
Head of Security & Compliance
FinSecure

[Attachment: FinSecure-Audit-Request-20260928.pdf]

From: michael_grant@redwood.com <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Karen Lee <security@finsecure.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation request: Dedicated region isolation & TTL proposals

Hi Karen — thanks for the clear list. Below are concise answers and attached artifacts; happy to walk through on a live call.

Summary (high level):
- Pin scope: Your tenant is region-pinned to us-west-2 primary, with a single cross-region snapshot replica (read-only) to us-west-2a for disaster recovery only. Persistent storage for tenant data and long-lived snapshots lives in the pinned region. Ephemeral KV/prefix caches and accelerated inference caches live on local node SSDs and are non-replicated by default. See attached pin-scope-diagram.pdf for the layout.
- Retention/TTL defaults and configurable ranges:
  * Model artifacts: default 90 days; configurable 30-365 days. Snapshots marked for deletion follow a 48-hour tombstone window before physical purge.
  * KV/prefix cache: TTL default 2 hours; configurable 0-24 hours. Cache is in-memory/local SSD and cleared on node recycle.
  * Inference logs (structured request/response logs): default 30 days; configurable 0-180 days per contract. Logs can be forwarded to your SIEM via our log-export hook.
  * Snapshots/backups: default retention 30 days; configurable 7-365 days. Snapshot delete triggers a background expunge job; see details below.
- Evidence for delete/wipe:
  * We can provide an ops-log-extract (sample) showing: delete request id, snapshot id, job start/end timestamps, and object deletion records.
  * For ephemeral caches, we can provide node-cycle events and cache-eviction logs.
  * For full tenant scrubs, we run our "wipe-playbook" which emits attestations to the audit log; we can produce a post-run summary CSV.
- Timeline for certified tenant wipe (typical):
  * Standard (no legal holds): 72 hours to complete logical deletion and 14 days for physical expunge across storage layers (accounting for snapshot Tombstone window and storage provider GC).
  * Accelerated (with approval): we can commit to a 7-day physical expunge path if a prioritized wipe is requested and the customer accepts temporary service interruption for snapshot purging.

Attachments included: pin-scope-diagram.pdf, ops-log-extract-20260928.csv (sample), wipe-playbook-summary.md (high-level playbook).

Open items for us to confirm with you on the call:
- Do you require no-replication guarantees (zero cross-region snapshots) or is a one-time DR replica acceptable?
- Desired maximum retention for inference logs for audit vs. privacy concerns.

If next week works, I have windows Tue/Wed 09:00-12:00 PT. Tell me a preferred slot and I will invite operations and Laura for legal sign-off.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

--

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: Karen Lee <security@finsecure.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation request: Dedicated region isolation & TTL proposals

FYI adding a couple of legal/acceptance notes — copying Karen so this is in-thread.

Michael — your breakdown looks good. A few clarifications from the contracts side:

- If FinSecure requires a strict no-replication SLA, we'll need a short amendment to the Dedicated contract to state that cross-region DR snapshots are disabled for the tenant. The operational impact is limited but it does remove a fast-restore path, which we should call out.
- For snapshot deletion, the 48-hour tombstone window is standard; legally we can shorten to 24 hours on request but would require a formal escalation and a prioritized maintenance window.
- Regarding evidence artifacts: please make sure the ops-log extract includes immutable event IDs and the hash of the deleted object (storage provider object id) so FinSecure can validate the purge.

Karen — if you confirm you want the no-replication amendment I can draft a short addendum. Otherwise we can proceed with the walkthrough and provide the audit sample artifacts.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Platforms
Redwood Inference

--

Looping in ops details and confirming we can meet the requests. Quick ops notes: 

- Confirmed: ephemeral cache TTL is 2 hours default; we can reduce/increase (0-24h) per tenant config. Node recycle evicts caches and produces a node-restart event in the audit log.
- Confirmed: snapshot tombstone lifecycle (48h) before expunge; expedited expunge requires a prioritized job with a maintenance window.
- Evidence: we will provide a sample ops-log-extract with the following columns: event_id, actor, object_id, object_hash, action, timestamp, job_id. Attached is a redacted sample (ops-log-extract-20260928.csv).
- Wipe-runbook: we maintain a documented playbook; attached is a summary. For the walkthrough we'll run through an anonymized dry-run and show the audit records.

Proposed attendees for the call: Michael (security), Irene (ops), Laura (legal), and Karen + 2 from FinSecure. Proposed time: 2026-10-06 10:00 AM PT (30 minutes).

--
Irene Choi
Manager, Service Operations
Redwood Inference
